protocol.selection: Fixed scenarios and budgets declared before outcomes; development study, not held-out final evaluation
protocol.scope: Complete full recipes in raw model; operation-column QUBO is explicitly restricted. Raw pruned QUBO compiled on two32-operation cases. References are classical. Quantum validation fixture remains separate.

parent_generation.scope: Seeded randomized topological list scheduling over raw finite domains; no time-indexed QUBO matrix built. Every complete parent independently checked.

pool.scope: All supplied component choices and cross-component BOM/resource constraints retained. Exact within restricted pool, not lossless full raw-model compression.

penalty_certificate.witness_source: Seeded list heuristic constructed before any CP reference
penalty_certificate.proof: Objective terms are nonnegative for every state. A checked feasible witness has energy U. Every infeasible state has energy >=P=U+1>U. Therefore all global minima remain feasible and globally objective-optimal in this exact domain. Feasible energies unchanged; non-optimal infeasible energies intentionally change.

pool.domain: Restricted operation pool, all raw operations retained; not lossless raw-domain compression

restriction.scope: Lossy finite unary-domain restriction. Precedence, resource, travel, setup and Cmax constraints remain global. No component route frozen.

pool_reference.scope: Native raw-column-pool reference. Bound applies to this supplied restricted pool only.
